description: This file contains extension methods for configuring Azure-specific deployment queue balancers within the Orleans hosting framework. The methods facilitate setting up either dynamic or static Azure deployment load balancers based on silo statuses and Azure deployment information.

methods.name: UseDynamicAzureDeploymentBalancer
methods.description: Configures a dynamic Azure deployment-based load balancer that adjusts queue distribution based on current silo statuses reported by Azure and Membership oracle.

methods.name: UseStaticAzureDeploymentBalancer
methods.description: Configures a static Azure deployment-based load balancer that uses Azure deployment information but does not react to changes in silo membership.
